weekly_archive.title: Prediction markets inch closer to the Supreme Court: State of Crypto
weekly_archive.description: New Jersey petitioned for a writ of certiorari in Kalshi's case against it last week, finally throwing the ball to the high court.
weekly_archive.summary: New Jersey petitioned the Supreme Court to review Kalshi's case, moving the legal battle over prediction markets closer to a high court decision that could clarify federal versus state regulatory authority. A ruling would have major implications for Kalshi and other event-contract platforms operating across state lines.
